info.title: Manual insurer receipt observations (P4-M5-B)
info.description: Nonposting manual receipt records and independent staff verification observations. A verified receipt does not post a payment or allocation.

get.description: Requires insurance_receipts.view and active tenant membership. Paginated; private/no-store. These are not invoice payments.

200.description: Paginated receipt observations in the standard API envelope.

403.description: Missing exact permission or active tenant access.

post.description: Requires insurance_receipts.record. Records staff-entered receipt evidence only. financial_posted is always false; no payment, allocation, receivable, invoice, or patient-balance mutation occurs. Retries with the same UUID key and payload replay the original receipt.

source_provenance.example: Staff recorded the deposit advice received from the clinic bank statement.

201.description: Nonposting receipt observation created; data.receipt.financial_posted is false.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an identical command.

404.description: Insurer not found in active tenant.

409.description: Duplicate external reference or idempotency key conflict.

422.description: Invalid decimal, currency, advice reference, or input.

get.description: Requires insurance_receipts.view. Reports any separate staff verification; financial_posted remains false.

200.description: Receipt and verification observation in the standard envelope.

403.description: Missing exact permission or active tenant access.

404.description: Receipt is outside the active tenant.

post.description: Requires insurance_receipts.verify. Verification must cite its method/provenance and exactly match receipt amount/currency. It does not post or allocate cash.

provenance.example: Compared with the statement reference reviewed by finance staff.

404.description: Receipt is outside the active tenant.

409.description: Already verified or observed amount/currency does not match.

TenantHeader.description: Optional tenant selector; active tenant membership is still required.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID command key for idempotent receipt creation.
